#### Archive Files

The following files are not ZIP archives: results.tar.gz. We recommend the `.zip` format for archives: only ZIP stores its file listing in a way that lets a tool inspect the contents without downloading the whole archive, so a `.zip` is more discoverable and re-usable than a `.7z`, `.rar`, or `.tar.gz`.
